key: ZERO: Sooo, how does this work?
en: ZERO: Sooo, how does this work?
ja: ゼロ: それでさ、これってどういう仕組みなんだ?

key: Do we just wander around this place until we find the problem?
en: Do we just wander around this place until we find the problem?
ja: 問題を見つけるまで、ここら辺をうろつくだけか?

key: Gotta say, I'm not used to looking for problems rather than causing them...
en: Gotta say, I'm not used to looking for problems rather than causing them...
ja: 正直、問題を起こす方じゃなくて探す方には、あんまり慣れてないんだけどな……

key: ZERO: Uhhhh... Found one?
en: ZERO: Uhhhh... Found one?
ja: ゼロ: ええと……見つけた、のか?

key: LIN: hey, SAME!
en: LIN: hey, SAME!
ja: リン: あ、あたしも一緒!

key: catch!!!
en: catch!!!
ja: 受け取って!!!

key: TAKA: You do this kind of thing all the time, right?
en: TAKA: You do this kind of thing all the time, right?
ja: タカ: 君って、いつもこういうことしてるんだよね?

key: It's... daunting, not knowing what I'm going to run into.
en: It's... daunting, not knowing what I'm going to run into.
ja: 何に出くわすか分からないのって……ちょっと怖いな。

key: But with you here, I get the feeling it'll be fine.
en: But with you here, I get the feeling it'll be fine.
ja: でも、君が一緒だと、なんとかなる気がするんだ。

key: I'm-- not really sure what I'm trying to say, just...
en: I'm-- not really sure what I'm trying to say, just...
ja: その――自分でも何が言いたいのか、よく分からないんだけど、ただ……

key: You've done a lot in my absence, huh?
en: You've done a lot in my absence, huh?
ja: 僕がいない間に、君はいろいろやってきたんだね。

key: You know, here, at the end of everything,
en: You know, here, at the end of everything,
ja: こうして、すべての終わりに立ってみると、

key: I'm just glad I'm not alone.
en: I'm just glad I'm not alone.
ja: 一人じゃないってだけで、本当によかったって思うよ。

key: Standing on my own after everything's over...
en: Standing on my own after everything's over...
ja: 全部が終わった後、一人で立つなんて……

key: My father's gone-- and...
en: My father's gone-- and...
ja: 父さんはもういなくて――それに……

key: That's... probably for the best.
en: That's... probably for the best.
ja: それは……たぶん、それでよかったんだと思う。

key: You also finally beat that woman, and--
en: You also finally beat that woman, and--
ja: 君もようやくあの女に勝って、それで――

key: TAKA: H-huh? What's this?!
en: TAKA: H-huh? What's this?!
ja: タカ: え? なにこれ!?

key: ANNA: Hi, \PN!
en: ANNA: Hi, \PN!
ja: アンナ: やあ、\PN!

key: I prepared a nice adventure for you and the boy with the broken wing!
en: I prepared a nice adventure for you and the boy with the broken wing!
ja: あなたと、羽の折れた男の子のために、素敵な冒険を用意したんだ!

key: You two can bond some more!
en: You two can bond some more!
ja: 二人でもっと仲良くなれるよ!

key: Hope you like it!
en: Hope you like it!
ja: 気に入ってくれるといいな!

key: TAKA: Uhh...
en: TAKA: Uhh...
ja: タカ: えっと……

key: LIN: hi, you were saying?
en: LIN: hi, you were saying?
ja: リン: はーい、なんだって?

key: LIN: "uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh"
en: LIN: "uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh"
ja: リン: 「えっとぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉ」

key: oh my GOD, even after you're supposed to have had your character arc, you still have the charisma of a paralyzed slugma.
en: oh my GOD, even after you're supposed to have had your character arc, you still have the charisma of a paralyzed slugma.
ja: うわマジで、キャラアークとやらが終わったはずなのに、いまだにマヒしたスラッグマ並みのカリスマ性じゃん。

key: TAKA: I--
en: TAKA: I--
ja: タカ: 僕は――

key: Okay, no, hold on; I'm at least a Magcargo now.
en: Okay, no, hold on; I'm at least a Magcargo now.
ja: いや、待って、僕は少なくとも今、マグカルゴにはなったから。

key: LIN: you wish.
en: LIN: you wish.
ja: リン: 願望乙。

key: ZERO: Hey, what the hell?!
en: ZERO: Hey, what the hell?!
ja: ゼロ: おい、なんだよこれ!?

key: TAKA: Uh, can we maybe talk about this?
en: TAKA: Uh, can we maybe talk about this?
ja: タカ: あの、これについて話し合えないかな?

key: LIN: NOPE!
en: LIN: NOPE!
ja: リン: ないね!

key: ANNA: I hope you two have fun~
en: ANNA: I hope you two have fun~
ja: アンナ: 二人とも、楽しんでね～

key: LIN: ...well i TOLD him to catch.
en: LIN: ...well i TOLD him to catch.
ja: リン: ……まあ、受け取れって言ったのはあたしだけど。

key: not my fault he sucks at it.
en: not my fault he sucks at it.
ja: 受け取り下手なのは、あたしのせいじゃないし。

key: anyway, let's have fun hanging out with the consolation prize now!
en: anyway, let's have fun hanging out with the consolation prize now!
ja: とにかく、参加賞と一緒に楽しくやろうよ!

key: you know what i mean, right?
en: you know what i mean, right?
ja: 言いたいこと、分かるでしょ?

key: like, nobody actually WANTS to deal with the stupid leftover grunt.
en: like, nobody actually WANTS to deal with the stupid leftover grunt.
ja: だってさ、あの残念な余りモンの下っ端と、本気で関わりたい人なんていないじゃん。

key: i'm surprised he even had the balls to step foot in here since i had terra try to kill him, LOL
en: i'm surprised he even had the balls to step foot in here since i had terra try to kill him, LOL
ja: テラに殺しかけさせといて、よくここに足踏み入れる度胸あったよね、笑

key: oh but i guess it's the brains he lacks.
en: oh but i guess it's the brains he lacks.
ja: あ、でも足りないのは度胸じゃなくて頭の方か。

key: that's why he had to go get eve in the first place, huh??
en: that's why he had to go get eve in the first place, huh??
ja: だからそもそも、イヴを迎えに行かなきゃいけなかったわけ??

key: leave him in the snow; you'll find ten guys like him on the street.
en: leave him in the snow; you'll find ten guys like him on the street.
ja: 雪の中に置いてきちゃえば? あんなやつ、道端に10人は転がってるし。

key: it's not like he isn't trying or anything-- he's just really that incapable!
en: it's not like he isn't trying or anything-- he's just really that incapable!
ja: 別に頑張ってないわけじゃないんだよ――ただ、本当にそれだけ無能ってだけ!

key: but isn't that--
en: but isn't that--
ja: でもそれって――

key: but at least he's worthless in like, an endearing way, right?
en: but at least he's worthless in like, an endearing way, right?
ja: でも少なくとも、なんか憎めない感じの役立たずではあるよね?

key: every other line is just to make himself look like the victim so everyone pities him--
en: every other line is just to make himself look like the victim so everyone pities him--
ja: セリフの半分は、みんなに同情してもらうために被害者ぶってるだけだし――

key: i guess some people just want to fix guys like that.
en: i guess some people just want to fix guys like that.
ja: まあ、ああいうタイプを直したがる人もいるんだろうね。

key: "maybe with enough kindness and love and he'll get better and love me too <33333"
en: "maybe with enough kindness and love and he'll get better and love me too <33333"
ja: 「優しさと愛情さえ十分あれば、きっと良くなって、あたしのことも好きになってくれるかも <33333」

key: isn't that just another way of manipulating someone?
en: isn't that just another way of manipulating someone?
ja: それって結局、人を操るための別のやり方なんじゃない?

key: even if the #depression is #relatable, are you really just going to sit there and delude yourself into thinking that's somehow okay?
en: even if the #depression is #relatable, are you really just going to sit there and delude yourself into thinking that's somehow okay?
ja: #鬱 が #わかる ってなったとしても、それが何かオッケーなことみたいに自分に思い込ませて、ただ座ってるつもりなの?

key: it's like-- "being that pathetic's a disease, get well soon~ xoxo"
en: it's like-- "being that pathetic's a disease, get well soon~ xoxo"
ja: なんかこう――「そこまで惨めなのって病気だよね、お大事に～ xoxo」みたいな。

key: anyway, it's not like i wouldn't know.
en: anyway, it's not like i wouldn't know.
ja: まあとにかく、あたしが知らないわけないっての。

key: i brought him back because it'll be more fun with him around!
en: i brought him back because it'll be more fun with him around!
ja: あいつを連れ戻したのは、いた方が楽しくなるからだし!

key: so let's play~
en: so let's play~
ja: だから遊ぼ～

key: we can keep playing forever, and ever, and--
en: we can keep playing forever, and ever, and--
ja: ずっと、ずっと、遊び続けられるし――

key: ohhh, he's waking up over there.
en: ohhh, he's waking up over there.
ja: あ、あそこで目を覚ましたみたい。

key: i'll stop monologuing and get back to it, okay?
en: i'll stop monologuing and get back to it, okay?
ja: 独り言はこのくらいにして、続きに戻るね?

key: let's go!!!
en: let's go!!!
ja: 行こう!!!

key: ZERO: What the hell...
en: ZERO: What the hell...
ja: ゼロ: なんだこりゃ……

key: ZERO: How am I supposed to get back up there?
en: ZERO: How am I supposed to get back up there?
ja: ゼロ: どうやってあそこまで戻ればいいんだ?

key: And what the hell was that--
en: And what the hell was that--
ja: つーか、さっきのは一体なんだったんだ――

key: No, I guess this is the job I signed up for.
en: No, I guess this is the job I signed up for.
ja: いや、これが自分で選んだ仕事ってやつなんだろうな。

key: Still beats what I've been doing with most of my life.
en: Still beats what I've been doing with most of my life.
ja: それでも、今までの人生でやってきたことよりはマシだ。

key: ZERO: The path connects further ahead, I think.
en: ZERO: The path connects further ahead, I think.
ja: ゼロ: この先で道がつながってると思う。

key: It looks like there's some junk in the way, but we can probably meet up further along.
en: It looks like there's some junk in the way, but we can probably meet up further along.
ja: 何かガラクタが邪魔してるみたいだけど、たぶんこの先で合流できるはずだ。

key: I'll follow your lead.
en: I'll follow your lead.
ja: お前についていく。

key: TAKA: I'm fine.
en: TAKA: I'm fine.
ja: タカ: 僕は大丈夫。

key: It's okay--
en: It's okay--
ja: 平気だから――

key: Don't worry about it.
en: Don't worry about it.
ja: 気にしないで。

key: TAKA: ...But I suppose I'm not getting back up there any time soon.
en: TAKA: ...But I suppose I'm not getting back up there any time soon.
ja: タカ: ……でも、しばらくはあそこに戻れそうにないね。

key: Tell me you usually get bowled over by the first Pokémon you see on these adventures.
en: Tell me you usually get bowled over by the first Pokémon you see on these adventures.
ja: こういう冒険では、いつも最初に出会うポケモンにやられちゃうんだって、言ってほしいな。

key: TAKA: I don't believe you, but it's sweet of you to try.
en: TAKA: I don't believe you, but it's sweet of you to try.
ja: タカ: 信じてはいないけど、そう言おうとしてくれるの、優しいね。

key: TAKA: Just me then?
en: TAKA: Just me then?
ja: タカ: じゃあ、僕だけなんだ?

key: That's fair.
en: That's fair.
ja: それも、まあ当然か。

key: TAKA: Looks like this'll connect if we keep going.
en: TAKA: Looks like this'll connect if we keep going.
ja: タカ: このまま進めば、つながりそうだね。

key: We might have obstacles to deal with, but...
en: We might have obstacles to deal with, but...
ja: 障害物と向き合うことになるかもしれないけど……

key: That's life, I guess.
en: That's life, I guess.
ja: それが人生ってやつなのかな。

key: I'll try to stay close to you, okay?
en: I'll try to stay close to you, okay?
ja: できるだけ、君のそばにいるようにするから、いい?

key: With you, I'm sure we can get through anything.
en: With you, I'm sure we can get through anything.
ja: 君となら、きっと何でも乗り越えられる。

key: (While in this area, press the A key to switch between characters.)
en: (While in this area, press the A key to switch between characters.)
ja: （このエリアでは、Aキーでキャラクターを切り替えられます。）

key: TAKA: Oh, \PN, it's just you...
en: TAKA: Oh, \PN, it's just you...
ja: タカ: ああ、\PN、なんだ、君か……

key: I thought I was about to get jumped or something.
en: I thought I was about to get jumped or something.
ja: 襲われるのかと思ったよ。

key: I came out here to try and...
en: I came out here to try and...
ja: ここに来たのは……

key: ...Help, I guess.
en: ...Help, I guess.
ja: ……手伝おうと思って、かな。

key: For once in my life.
en: For once in my life.
ja: 人生で一度くらいは。

key: Take action.
en: Take action.
ja: 行動を起こすんだ。

key: I wasn't expecting it to be so cold here though.
en: I wasn't expecting it to be so cold here though.
ja: でも、ここまで寒いとは思ってなかったな。

key: Think I'll need more than a scarf for this.
en: Think I'll need more than a scarf for this.
ja: これはマフラーだけじゃ足りなさそうだ。

key: You wanna come with me again?
en: You wanna come with me again?
ja: また一緒に来てくれる?

key: Just like in Tourmaline.
en: Just like in Tourmaline.
ja: トルマリンのときみたいに。

key: But, like, I'll try not to die this time.
en: But, like, I'll try not to die this time.
ja: でも、まあ、今回は死なないように気をつけるよ。

key: Kinda over that.
en: Kinda over that.
ja: あれはもう懲り懲りだから。

key: Come on!
en: Come on!
ja: さあ　来い!

key: I... don't really know why I came out here.
en: I... don't really know why I came out here.
ja: 僕……なんでここに来たのか、自分でもよく分からないんだ。

key: Like I said before, just to do my part, I guess.
en: Like I said before, just to do my part, I guess.
ja: 前にも言ったけど、自分にできることをするため、かな。

key: Think I'll need more than a scarf for this...
en: Think I'll need more than a scarf for this...
ja: これはマフラーだけじゃ足りなさそうだ……

key: Do you mind going with me?
en: Do you mind going with me?
ja: 一緒に来てもらってもいい?

key: I'll feel a lot more like I know what I'm doing with an entire champion behind me for it.
en: I'll feel a lot more like I know what I'm doing with an entire champion behind me for it.
ja: チャンピオンがそばにいてくれるだけで、自分が何をしてるのか分かってる気になれるんだ。

key: Let's see what's ahead.
en: Let's see what's ahead.
ja: この先を見てみよう。

key: ZERO: ...Ah, \PN.
en: ZERO: ...Ah, \PN.
ja: ゼロ: ……ああ、\PN。

key: Everyone else has been jittering with all of the Legendaries they've caught, anomalies they've shut out, and all of that...
en: Everyone else has been jittering with all of the Legendaries they've caught, anomalies they've shut out, and all of that...
ja: 他のみんなは、捕まえた伝説のポケモンとか、封じたアノマリーとか、そういう話で浮かれてるみたいだけど……

key: I decided I didn't wanna stay behind the desk forever.
en: I decided I didn't wanna stay behind the desk forever.
ja: 俺はずっとデスクの後ろにいるのは嫌だって決めたんだ。

key: ...Who sent you after me? I didn't request help.
en: ...Who sent you after me? I didn't request help.
ja: ……誰が俺を追わせたんだ? 助けなんて頼んでないぞ。

key: Ah, that little Smeargle...
en: Ah, that little Smeargle...
ja: ああ、あのちっちゃいドーブルか……

key: I suppose it thought I needed the help.
en: I suppose it thought I needed the help.
ja: 俺に助けが必要だと思ったんだろうな。

key: I hope to prove it wrong, but...
en: I hope to prove it wrong, but...
ja: そいつが間違ってるって証明したいところだが……

key: ...It picked a good person for the job, I guess.
en: ...It picked a good person for the job, I guess.
ja: ……まあ、頼む相手は選んだって感じだな。

key: No, I should be helping you-- not the other way around.
en: No, I should be helping you-- not the other way around.
ja: いや、俺の方がお前を助けるべきなんだ――逆じゃなくて。

key: I owe you.
en: I owe you.
ja: 借りがあるからな。

key: For helping Lumi, I mean.
en: For helping Lumi, I mean.
ja: ルミを助けてくれたことに対して、だよ。

key: I may have been the one that... got in the way, but...
en: I may have been the one that... got in the way, but...
ja: 邪魔をしたのは……俺の方だったかもしれないけど……

key: You can't get so close to someone and not get at least a little bit of them mixed up in you.
en: You can't get so close to someone and not get at least a little bit of them mixed up in you.
ja: 誰かとあれだけ近くにいれば、多少なりともその人の一部が自分に混ざり込むもんだ。

key: I'm keeping my distance, but if anything happened to her or Eve now...
en: I'm keeping my distance, but if anything happened to her or Eve now...
ja: 距離は置いてるつもりだけど、もし今、あいつやイヴに何かあったら……

key: ...Well, I don't know who I'd be.
en: ...Well, I don't know who I'd be.
ja: ……自分が何者なのか、分からなくなりそうだ。

key: A-anyway, that's enough sap from me.
en: A-anyway, that's enough sap from me.
ja: と、とにかく、感傷的な話はこのくらいにしとくか。

key: We've got a job to do or whatever.
en: We've got a job to do or whatever.
ja: やるべきことがあるんだろ、多分。

key: Abomasnow is staring at the sky in anticipation.
en: Abomasnow is staring at the sky in anticipation.
ja: ユキノオーが、期待するように空を見つめている。

key: Activate Abomasnow's Snow Warning?
en: Activate Abomasnow's Snow Warning?
ja: ユキノオーの「ゆきふらし」を発動させますか?

key: ABOMASNOW: Abobaa!
en: ABOMASNOW: Abobaa!
ja: ユキノオー: アボバー!

key: You left the Abomasnow alone.
en: You left the Abomasnow alone.
ja: ユキノオーをそのままにした。

key: Abomasnow seems to be having a staring contest with its reflection in the ice.
en: Abomasnow seems to be having a staring contest with its reflection in the ice.
ja: ユキノオーは、氷に映った自分の姿とにらめっこしているようだ。

key: It appears too cold to activate.
en: It appears too cold to activate.
ja: 発動させるには、寒すぎるようだ。

key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: 鍵が　クリスタルに　反応した!

key: The crystal glitters with reflections of starlight.
en: The crystal glitters with reflections of starlight.
ja: クリスタルが、星明かりを映してきらめいている。

key: The ice crystals appear brittle and breakable.
en: The ice crystals appear brittle and breakable.
ja: 氷のクリスタルは、もろく壊れやすそうだ。

key: ZERO: ...Handy.
en: ZERO: ...Handy.
ja: ゼロ: ……便利だな。

key: I'll just assume \v[38] can do something with that.
en: I'll just assume \v[38] can do something with that.
ja: \v[38]がそれで何かできるってことにしとくか。

key: TAKA: ...Hmm.
en: TAKA: ...Hmm.
ja: タカ: ……うーん。

key: I hope I was supposed to do that.
en: I hope I was supposed to do that.
ja: これでよかったのかな。

key: ZERO: ...Sounds like ice shattering?
en: ZERO: ...Sounds like ice shattering?
ja: ゼロ: ……氷が割れる音か?

key: ...Just gonna hope that's not a bad thing.
en: ...Just gonna hope that's not a bad thing.
ja: ……悪いことじゃないって信じることにする。

key: TAKA: Did I just hear ice break somewhere?
en: TAKA: Did I just hear ice break somewhere?
ja: タカ: 今、どこかで氷が割れる音がしなかった?

key: ...All right, you do you, crystal thing.
en: ...All right, you do you, crystal thing.
ja: ……まあ、好きにやってよ、クリスタルさん。

key: Frankly, thanks for doing anything at all.
en: Frankly, thanks for doing anything at all.
ja: 正直、何かしてくれるだけでもありがたいよ。

key: Altaria seems to dislike the lightly falling snow.
en: Altaria seems to dislike the lightly falling snow.
ja: チルタリスは、静かに降る雪が気に入らないようだ。

key: Activate Altaria's Cloud Nine?
en: Activate Altaria's Cloud Nine?
ja: チルタリスの「くもりのちはれ」を発動させますか?

key: ALTARIA: Allllll!
en: ALTARIA: Allllll!
ja: チルタリス: アルルル!

key: You left the Altaria alone.
en: You left the Altaria alone.
ja: チルタリスをそのままにした。

key: Altaria seems bewildered by the fallen snow.
en: Altaria seems bewildered by the fallen snow.
ja: チルタリスは、積もった雪に戸惑っているようだ。

key: The ice crystals appear too frozen to be broken.
en: The ice crystals appear too frozen to be broken.
ja: 氷のクリスタルは、凍りついていて壊せそうにない。

key: ZERO: Well this wasn't here before.
en: ZERO: Well this wasn't here before.
ja: ゼロ: これ、前はなかったよな。

key: Not that I'm complaining.
en: Not that I'm complaining.
ja: 文句はないけどさ。

key: I guess I shouldn't be surprised that \v[38] gets things done.
en: I guess I shouldn't be surprised that \v[38] gets things done.
ja: \v[38]が物事をやり遂げるのは、今さら驚くことでもないか。

key: TAKA: \v[38] made this appear, huh?
en: TAKA: \v[38] made this appear, huh?
ja: タカ: \v[38]がこれを出現させたんだね?

key: Funny how some people look out for you better than your own blood.
en: Funny how some people look out for you better than your own blood.
ja: 実の血縁より、他人の方が自分を気にかけてくれることもあるんだね、変な話だけど。

key: ZERO: Easy there...
en: ZERO: Easy there...
ja: ゼロ: おいおい……

key: Can't solve all your problems with brute force.
en: Can't solve all your problems with brute force.
ja: 全部の問題を力ずくで解決できるわけじゃないんだぞ。

key: If only it were that simple...
en: If only it were that simple...
ja: そんな単純だったらよかったんだけどな……

key: But it seems like when the snow piles up, we can get over some other cliffs.
en: But it seems like when the snow piles up, we can get over some other cliffs.
ja: でも、雪が積もれば、他の崖も越えられそうだ。

key: That's something at least.
en: That's something at least.
ja: 少しは進展があったってことか。

key: TAKA: Yeah, that sounds rough.
en: TAKA: Yeah, that sounds rough.
ja: タカ: うん、それは大変そうだね。

key: Just let it all out, I guess.
en: Just let it all out, I guess.
ja: 全部吐き出しちゃっていいよ。

key: ABOMASNOW: Abobaa!!
en: ABOMASNOW: Abobaa!!
ja: ユキノオー: アボバー!!

key: TAKA: I know, I know. It sounds like it's been hard for you.
en: TAKA: I know, I know. It sounds like it's been hard for you.
ja: タカ: 分かるよ、分かる。大変だったんだね。

key: Hang in there.
en: Hang in there.
ja: 頑張って。

key: In the meantime, I think I see some of the snow piling up just enough to get us over a cliff or two...
en: In the meantime, I think I see some of the snow piling up just enough to get us over a cliff or two...
ja: その間に、雪が崖を一つか二つ越えられるくらいには積もってきた気がする……

key: Abomasnow seems to be content in the chilly air.
en: Abomasnow seems to be content in the chilly air.
ja: ユキノオーは、冷たい空気の中で満足しているようだ。

key: ZERO: You and me both, buddy.
en: ZERO: You and me both, buddy.
ja: ゼロ: 俺も同じ気持ちだよ、相棒。

key: TAKA: Not a fan of the weather, huh?
en: TAKA: Not a fan of the weather, huh?
ja: タカ: この天気、あんまり好きじゃないんだ?

key: Tell you what though, it sure beats the desert.
en: Tell you what though, it sure beats the desert.
ja: でも、砂漠よりはマシだよね。

key: I'll bring a spare scarf for you next time.
en: I'll bring a spare scarf for you next time.
ja: 今度、予備のマフラー持ってくるよ。

key: Altaria is roosting calmly.
en: Altaria is roosting calmly.
ja: チルタリスが、静かにねぐらについている。

key: ZERO: Tch, what even is this?
en: ZERO: Tch, what even is this?
ja: ゼロ: チッ、これ一体なんなんだよ。

key: How does energy just freeze?
en: How does energy just freeze?
ja: エネルギーがどうやって凍るんだ?

key: Maybe it's all this hail?
en: Maybe it's all this hail?
ja: このあられのせいか?

key: TAKA: ...Ah, so perhaps we have to do something about the snow.
en: TAKA: ...Ah, so perhaps we have to do something about the snow.
ja: タカ: ……ああ、たぶん雪をどうにかしないといけないんだね。

key: It can never be easy, can it?
en: It can never be easy, can it?
ja: 簡単にはいかないもんだね。

key: ZERO: ...Okay, hopefully that did anything.
en: ZERO: ...Okay, hopefully that did anything.
ja: ゼロ: ……よし、何か効果があったといいけどな。

key: Now how do I get out of here?
en: Now how do I get out of here?
ja: さて、ここからどうやって出ればいいんだ?

key: TAKA: ...I... think that's all to do at this end?
en: TAKA: ...I... think that's all to do at this end?
ja: タカ: ……こっち側でやることは、これで全部だと思う?

key: Okay, \v[38], set me free.
en: Okay, \v[38], set me free.
ja: よし、\v[38]、僕を自由にしてくれ。

key: ...You know, again.
en: ...You know, again.
ja: ……また、っていう意味でね。

key: Altaria let out a sudden cry!
en: Altaria let out a sudden cry!
ja: チルタリスが、突然鳴き声を上げた!

key: Altaria seems to be preoccupied trying to stay warm.
en: Altaria seems to be preoccupied trying to stay warm.
ja: チルタリスは、暖かくしていることに気を取られているようだ。

key: ABOMASNOW: Sno-snow!
en: ABOMASNOW: Sno-snow!
ja: ユキノオー: スノー、スノー!

key: Abomasnow is focused on staring at the crystal.
en: Abomasnow is focused on staring at the crystal.
ja: ユキノオーは、クリスタルを見つめることに集中している。

key: ALTARIA: Al-taa!
en: ALTARIA: Al-taa!
ja: チルタリス: アルターア!

key: Altaria seems to be enjoying the company.
en: Altaria seems to be enjoying the company.
ja: チルタリスは、一緒にいるのを楽しんでいるようだ。

key: Pet Altaria?
en: Pet Altaria?
ja: チルタリスをなでますか?

key: ALTARIA: Aria!
en: ALTARIA: Aria!
ja: チルタリス: アリア!

key: Altaria is overjoyed! It nuzzles into the pet gently.
en: Altaria is overjoyed! It nuzzles into the pet gently.
ja: チルタリスは大喜び! そっと甘えるように身を寄せてきた。

key: ALTARIA: .....Alt?
en: ALTARIA: .....Alt?
ja: チルタリス: ……アル?

key: Altaria returns to staring at the stars.
en: Altaria returns to staring at the stars.
ja: チルタリスは、また星を見つめ始めた。

key: ABOMASNOW: Abo!
en: ABOMASNOW: Abo!
ja: ユキノオー: アボ!

key: Abomasnow is trying not to slip on the ice.
en: Abomasnow is trying not to slip on the ice.
ja: ユキノオーは、氷の上で滑らないようにしている。

key: Altaria tries to bury its head in the snow. Evidently, this was a mist-ake.
en: Altaria tries to bury its head in the snow. Evidently, this was a mist-ake.
ja: チルタリスは、雪に頭を埋めようとした。どうやら、それはとんだ思い違いだったようだ。

key: Abomasnow shifted slightly.
en: Abomasnow shifted slightly.
ja: ユキノオーが、わずかに動いた。

key: Abomasnow appears to be very interested in the nearby trees.
en: Abomasnow appears to be very interested in the nearby trees.
ja: ユキノオーは、近くの木々にとても興味があるようだ。

key: Abomasnow appears to be preoccupied trying to blend in with the grass.
en: Abomasnow appears to be preoccupied trying to blend in with the grass.
ja: ユキノオーは、草に紛れようと必死になっているようだ。

key: Skip New World Helix puzzle on this file?
en: Skip New World Helix puzzle on this file?
ja: このファイルでは、ニューワールドヘリックスのパズルをスキップしますか?

key: ABOMASNOW: Snoow!
en: ABOMASNOW: Snoow!
ja: ユキノオー: スノーウ!

key: Abomasnow suddenly looks happy! There's snow way to know what it's thinking.
en: Abomasnow suddenly looks happy! There's snow way to know what it's thinking.
ja: ユキノオーは、急にうれしそうな顔をした! 何を考えているのかは、まったくわからない。

key: ALTARIA: Alllt!
en: ALTARIA: Alllt!
ja: チルタリス: アルルト!

key: Altaria seems to enjoy resting on top of the rock.
en: Altaria seems to enjoy resting on top of the rock.
ja: チルタリスは、岩の上で休むのを楽しんでいるようだ。

key: ZERO: There's the door.
en: ZERO: There's the door.
ja: ゼロ: あそこに扉がある。

key: Almost there... but I don't actually see a way to get to it.
en: Almost there... but I don't actually see a way to get to it.
ja: もう少しだけど……でも、実際どうやってそこまで行けばいいのか分からないな。

key: ...Tch, I'm probably keeping \v[38] waiting.
en: ...Tch, I'm probably keeping \v[38] waiting.
ja: ……チッ、たぶん\v[38]を待たせちまってるな。

key: TAKA: Oh, an exit.
en: TAKA: Oh, an exit.
ja: タカ: あ、出口だ。

key: That's always nice.
en: That's always nice.
ja: それはいつだってうれしいよね。

key: ...If only there were a way to get to it.
en: ...If only there were a way to get to it.
ja: ……そこまでの行き方さえあればいいんだけど。

key: ZERO: ...
en: ZERO: ...
ja: ゼロ: ……

key: So, thanks.
en: So, thanks.
ja: だから、ありがとな。

key: Don't really know what I would've done if I'd been alone here.
en: Don't really know what I would've done if I'd been alone here.
ja: ここに一人だったら、俺、どうしてたか分からない。

key: ...Gotta be honest, part of me's still not used to having to go into emergency control mode every time you show up.
en: ...Gotta be honest, part of me's still not used to having to go into emergency control mode every time you show up.
ja: ……正直言うと、お前が現れるたびに緊急対応モードに入らなきゃいけないの、いまだに慣れない部分があるんだ。

key: Now that we're not enemies anymore...
en: Now that we're not enemies anymore...
ja: もう敵同士じゃなくなったのに……

key: ...I don't know why I feel so bitter.
en: ...I don't know why I feel so bitter.
ja: ……なんでこんなに苦い気持ちになるのか、分からない。

key: ZERO: All right, that's not true.
en: ZERO: All right, that's not true.
ja: ゼロ: いや、それはうそだ。

key: I know why, and this isn't helping.
en: I know why, and this isn't helping.
ja: 理由は分かってる、それにこれは何の助けにもなってない。

key: I don't exactly get much appreciation on my own.
en: I don't exactly get much appreciation on my own.
ja: 俺自身、あんまり感謝されるようなことしてないからな。

key: The appreciation is... just a side effect really.
en: The appreciation is... just a side effect really.
ja: 感謝ってのは……本当は、ただのおまけみたいなもんだ。

key: People who get shit done get the praise.
en: People who get shit done get the praise.
ja: ちゃんと物事をやり遂げる奴が、褒められるんだ。

key: I can't even get shit done.
en: I can't even get shit done.
ja: 俺は、まともに物事をやり遂げることすらできない。

key: Not by myself.
en: Not by myself.
ja: 自分一人じゃな。

key: I'm always being carried by Eve, or Lin, or now you...
en: I'm always being carried by Eve, or Lin, or now you...
ja: いつもイヴか、リンか、今はお前に運ばれてるだけなんだ……

key: ...And if not, I flat out fail.
en: ...And if not, I flat out fail.
ja: ……そうじゃなきゃ、完全に失敗する。

key: How is this different?
en: How is this different?
ja: これの何が違うんだ?

key: I can't hold a candle to anyone.
en: I can't hold a candle to anyone.
ja: 誰と比べても、俺なんか足元にも及ばない。

key: Been like that my whole life.
en: Been like that my whole life.
ja: ずっとそうだったんだ。

key: And what am I supposed to do with that, be content?
en: And what am I supposed to do with that, be content?
ja: それで、俺はどうすればいいんだ、満足しろってのか?

key: Be better?
en: Be better?
ja: もっとマシになれって?

key: As if I'm not already trying?!
en: As if I'm not already trying?!
ja: 俺がもう頑張ってないとでも思ってんのか!?

key: Sorry, this isn't your fault.
en: Sorry, this isn't your fault.
ja: 悪い、お前のせいじゃないんだ。

key: You're just the latest grain of salt in my wound.
en: You're just the latest grain of salt in my wound.
ja: お前はただ、俺の傷に振られた、最新の塩ってだけだ。

key: The door's over there, so...
en: The door's over there, so...
ja: 扉はあっちだから……

key: I'm gonna go through it now.
en: I'm gonna go through it now.
ja: もう通り抜けるとするか。

key: TAKA: Well I can't say that wasn't at least a little bit fun, but I'm glad to be over with it!
en: TAKA: Well I can't say that wasn't at least a little bit fun, but I'm glad to be over with it!
ja: タカ: 少しは楽しかったって言えなくもないけど、終わってよかったよ!

key: I saw the door is straight above.
en: I saw the door is straight above.
ja: 扉は、真上にあるのが見えたよ。

key: What do you bet I get run over by a Buzzwole the second I walk through it?
en: What do you bet I get run over by a Buzzwole the second I walk through it?
ja: 扉をくぐった瞬間、マッシブーンにひかれる方に賭ける?

key: TAKA: ...Well, let's find out.
en: TAKA: ...Well, let's find out.
ja: タカ: ……まあ、確かめてみよう。

key: TAKA: But by now, I suppose I've been through worse.
en: TAKA: But by now, I suppose I've been through worse.
ja: タカ: でも、今となってはもっとひどい目にも遭ってきたし。

key: Bring on the Buzzwole.
en: Bring on the Buzzwole.
ja: マッシブーン、かかってこい。

key: ZERO: Gotta be at least halfway now...
en: ZERO: Gotta be at least halfway now...
ja: ゼロ: もう半分は来てるはずだよな……

key: And what've I done for it?
en: And what've I done for it?
ja: それで、俺は一体何をしたっていうんだ?

key: Tch.
en: Tch.
ja: チッ。

key: TAKA: Center's getting closer.
en: TAKA: Center's getting closer.
ja: タカ: 中心が近づいてきたね。

key: Maybe halfway by now?
en: Maybe halfway by now?
ja: もう半分くらいかな?

key: I guess this isn't so bad...
en: I guess this isn't so bad...
ja: そんなに悪くないかも……

key: ZERO: It's seriously way too cold here.
en: ZERO: It's seriously way too cold here.
ja: ゼロ: マジでここ、寒すぎるだろ。

key: Whose idea was this?
en: Whose idea was this?
ja: 誰の発案だよ、これ。

key: And Lumi actually LIKES this type?
en: And Lumi actually LIKES this type?
ja: しかもルミ、こういうタイプ、本気で好きなのか?

key: TAKA: It's getting colder as we get further...
en: TAKA: It's getting colder as we get further...
ja: タカ: 進むほど、寒くなってくるね……

key: Maybe I shoulda brought a second scarf for myself.
en: Maybe I shoulda brought a second scarf for myself.
ja: 自分用にもう一枚、マフラー持ってくればよかったかな。

key: Nothing a bit of our own fire won't take care of though.
en: Nothing a bit of our own fire won't take care of though.
ja: でも、自前の炎があれば何とかなるよね。

key: ZERO: Ugh, more?
en: ZERO: Ugh, more?
ja: ゼロ: うげ、まだあんのか?

key: Here I thought we'd finally gotten to the end of this.
en: Here I thought we'd finally gotten to the end of this.
ja: やっと終わったと思ってたのに。

key: So, what, I just have to make it all the right color?
en: So, what, I just have to make it all the right color?
ja: つまり何だ、全部正しい色にすればいいのか?

key: How should I even know which one is right?
en: How should I even know which one is right?
ja: どれが正しいかなんて、俺に分かるわけないだろ。

key: Well, I'm not about to fall behind now.
en: Well, I'm not about to fall behind now.
ja: まあ、今さら後れを取るつもりはないけどな。

key: I'm sick of that anyway.
en: I'm sick of that anyway.
ja: どうせ、それにはもうウンザリしてるし。

key: TAKA: Finally here...
en: TAKA: Finally here...
ja: タカ: やっと着いた……

key: Now what's all this?
en: Now what's all this?
ja: これは一体、何だろう?

key: I guess there's an obvious shape to complete...
en: I guess there's an obvious shape to complete...
ja: 完成させるべき形が、はっきり見えてる気がするな……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
